title: Medtronic, frequently disconnecting on 3.4.2.1
symptom: Users report frequent disconnection issues with Medtronic 754/722 pumps, possibly since January changes. One user on 3.4.2.3 reports only connects on phone reboot once then can no longer connect.
fix: Downgrading to version 3.3.2.1 appears to resolve the issue for some users.
evidence_quote: 3.3.2.1 is the version I've gone back to, will try 3.4.0.0, thanks
